messages:
Aisha: Heads-up: small follow-up patch to the migration guide to include a snippet that shows how to interpret legacy 'user_id' vs new 'user_identifier' fields. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4902
Tom: Helpful. Can you drop the legacy->new mapping table here so I can copy it into an internal ticket?
Aisha: quick mapping: `user_id` -> `user_identifier` (now includes prefix to show source, e.g., 'user:'), `tenant` -> `tenant_id`, `ts` -> `timestamp` (ISO8601). Also note payload nesting changed: `response.tokens` moved to top-level `payload.tokens` in v2.
Rafael: Also ensure we call out that some legacy exports redacted differently (masking with ****). Add a short note: "If you relied on pre-v2 mask format, update your parsers."
DocsBot: lint: please add a cross-link to the audit export CLI doc.
Aisha: Added the link and a tiny code block showing a jq filter to normalize both legacy and v2 rows: `jq '.timestamp = .ts // .timestamp | .user_identifier = .user_identifier // ("user:" + .user_id)'
Marco: Good call. Security: the note about masking should also say "masking is not a guarantee of de-identification" and link to the deid policy.
Aisha: Added that sentence and link. Pushing the change now.
security-bot: reminder: include sample retention matrix for SOC2 scope - public doc can show default 365d and options for legal hold and extended retention with enterprise SLA.
Aisha: Added a compact retention matrix (one-line) and linked to legal hold runbook. PR ready for reviews.
Tom: Approved from docs side. Rafael/Marco please take a look for privacy/legal.
